annotations.bnjettag.io/status: memory canary (wave-2 STUDY launch gates 7 and 14): one pod on NVIDIA-A10; phases E-k4 (4 arms), E-k5 (5 arms), A07-k3 (3 arms), 110 epochs each, sequential; output /data/delta-20260927/canary-v2/k_result.json; TEMPLATE until PREFLIGHT
annotations.bnjettag.io/rss-gate: per phase BNJ_RSS_GATE_LIMIT_MB = 2,100 + 5 x H of the replica configs, window 5:105
annotations.bnjettag.io/per-arm-memory: 36Gi = the largest phase (K x per-arm Gi)
annotations.bnjettag.io/gate15: fingerprint_check.py (rep-A s1 initial_ebops == 11,559,681) before any ARM_STARTED; exit 9 mismatch, 8 no GPU; excludes hcc-nrp-shor-c6017.unl.edu (REGRESSION_TICKET 2026-09-28)

containers.name: train
args:
set -euo pipefail
export KERAS_BACKEND=tensorflow MPLBACKEND=Agg TF_CPP_MIN_LOG_LEVEL=2
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=2 TF_NUM_INTRAOP_THREADS=2 TF_NUM_INTEROP_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1
mkdir -p /work/code
echo '705a554b8da0395bf015a60743a0ea97304ecb9261c3a43d8619404f5c4c6f98  /cmcode/hgq2.tar.gz' | sha256sum -c -
tar -xzf /cmcode/hgq2.tar.gz -C /work/code --strip-components=1
export PYTHONPATH=/work/code
# roots come from the dict-form packs file (run_pack.py, Delta patch 0038); never from the environment
unset BNJ_DATA_ROOT BNJ_RUN_ROOT
export BNJ_CAMPAIGN_DIR=/work/code/campaigns/delta0926 BNJ_STAGE=canary BNJ_RSS_GATE_WINDOW=5:105
export TF_FORCE_GPU_ALLOW_GROWTH=true NVIDIA_TF32_OVERRIDE=0
unset WANDB_PROJECT   # every config says train.wandb_project BNJetTag-Delta; run_engram checks env == config
export WANDB_ENTITY=kayamaguchi-uc-san-diego WANDB_MODE=online WANDB_TAGS=delta0926,wave2,memory-canary,validation-only
export WANDB_DIR=/work WANDB_CACHE_DIR=/work/wandb-cache WANDB_DATA_DIR=/work/wandb-data WANDB_DISABLE_CODE=true WANDB_QUIET=true
pip install -q --no-cache-dir -r /work/code/requirements-training.txt
NVLIBS=$(python -c "import glob; print(':'.join(sorted(glob.glob('/usr/local/lib/python*/site-packages/nvidia/*/lib'))))")
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="$NVLIBS${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:+:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH}"
cd /work/code
MSHA=$(python -c "import run_study; print(run_study.manifest()['sha256'])")
test "$MSHA" = "300be87bf0cde5fba95c7b9cf0798718475e2b2dd6a230ee44a58a22fa8d467c" || { echo "MANIFEST_SHA_MISMATCH $MSHA"; exit 1; }
echo "MANIFEST_SHA_OK $MSHA"
export BNHGQ2_CODE_SHA256="$MSHA"
python -c "import tensorflow as tf; assert tf.config.list_physical_devices('GPU'); print('GPU_GATE_PASS')"
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=name,memory.total --format=csv,noheader || true
df -h /data
python - <<'PY'
import json, os, pathlib, sys
p = json.load(open(os.path.join(os.environ["BNJ_CAMPAIGN_DIR"], "delta_canary_packs.json")))
idx = range(len(p["packs"])) if "1" == "1" else [int(os.environ["JOB_COMPLETION_INDEX"])]
bad = [(m["data_root"], n) for i in idx for m in [p["pack_meta"][i]] for n in m["n_parts"]
       if not pathlib.Path(m["data_root"], f"n{n}", "data", "READY.json").is_file()]
print("CACHE_NOT_READY" if bad else "CACHE_READY", bad or ""); sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)
PY
test -f /data/chang-n64-20260926/n64/data/READY.json || { echo "GATE15_CACHE_NOT_READY /data/chang-n64-20260926"; exit 9; }
python -u /work/code/campaigns/delta0926/fingerprint_check.py --env-report --data-root /data/chang-n64-20260926 || { rc=$?; echo "GATE15_FAIL exit $rc"; exit $rc; }
echo GATE15_PASS
CAN=/data/delta-20260927/canary-v2; mkdir -p $CAN; echo start > $CAN/phase
FAIL=0
export BNJ_ARM_RETRIES=0 BNJ_POD_STALL_RETRIES=0   # an OOM or a stall is the measurement: never retried
( set +e; while true; do P=$(cat $CAN/phase); T=$(date +%s); nvidia-smi --query-gpu=name,memory.total,memory.used --format=csv,noheader,nounits | sed "s/^/$T,$P,gpu,/" >> $CAN/gpu_samples.csv; nvidia-smi --query-compute-apps=pid,used_memory --format=csv,noheader,nounits | sed "s/^/$T,$P,app,/" >> $CAN/gpu_samples.csv; sleep 10; done ) & SAMPLER=$!
echo E-k4 > $CAN/phase; mkdir -p $CAN/E-k4; BNJ_STAGE=canary BNJ_RSS_GATE_LIMIT_MB=7100 JOB_COMPLETION_INDEX=0 python -u /work/code/run_pack.py delta_canary_packs.json 110 2>&1 | tee $CAN/E-k4/pack.log || { echo PHASE_EXIT_NONZERO E-k4; FAIL=1; }   # pack.log keeps ARM_STARTED pids and POD_MEM lines
echo E-k5 > $CAN/phase; mkdir -p $CAN/E-k5; BNJ_STAGE=canary BNJ_RSS_GATE_LIMIT_MB=4600 JOB_COMPLETION_INDEX=1 python -u /work/code/run_pack.py delta_canary_packs.json 110 2>&1 | tee $CAN/E-k5/pack.log || { echo PHASE_EXIT_NONZERO E-k5; FAIL=1; }   # pack.log keeps ARM_STARTED pids and POD_MEM lines
echo A07-k3 > $CAN/phase; mkdir -p $CAN/A07-k3; BNJ_STAGE=canary BNJ_RSS_GATE_LIMIT_MB=12100 JOB_COMPLETION_INDEX=2 python -u /work/code/run_pack.py delta_canary_packs.json 110 2>&1 | tee $CAN/A07-k3/pack.log || { echo PHASE_EXIT_NONZERO A07-k3; FAIL=1; }   # pack.log keeps ARM_STARTED pids and POD_MEM lines
echo done > $CAN/phase; sleep 20; kill $SAMPLER || true
python -u /work/code/campaigns/delta0926/canary_k.py --samples $CAN/gpu_samples.csv --packs /work/code/campaigns/delta0926/delta_canary_packs.json --run-root $CAN --out $CAN/k_result.json || echo CANARY_K_INCOMPLETE
cat $CAN/k_result.json
test "$FAIL" = 0 || { echo CANARY_PHASES_FAILED; exit 7; }
